changelog: Added bridge exports for inventory stash and hook registration through the configured ACN or ox inventory.
/acn_versions no longer gets stuck and now lists resources with a missing version file or a failed check.
Society money sync can no longer be triggered by non-admin players.
Client GetJobs now returns the real ESX jobs.
Errors in third-party inventory, target, progress and notify scripts no longer crash the calling script.
Vehicle spawn authorization no longer errors when the anti-cheat export is missing or not ready.
ResetNeeds compatible avec la protection anti-triche d'acn_status 1.4.0.
/acn_restart_all redémarre automatiquement tous les scripts ACN déjà démarrés, sans liste à maintenir.
Nouveaux exports AddTargetGlobalPlayer et RemoveTargetGlobalPlayer pour cibler les joueurs avec ox_target ou qb-target.
